# Build Guide: Feral Ghoul Unarmed Melee (Reverse Charge)

![Build Guide: Feral Ghoul Unarmed Melee (Reverse Onslaught)](/uploads/476_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

From March 18, 2025 it will be possible to play as a ghoul in Fallout 76. This brings new advantages and disadvantages. In addition to radiation resistance and glow (which acts like a kind of shield), there are also new perks that enable completely new builds.

### Wild as a melee base

The basis for this ghoul build is its "Wild" status (English: "Feral"). We can specify this as the basis for the build such as: also "bloodstained" in humans. By the way, a ghoul cannot play Bloodstained because all radiation for healing is absorbed and there is no radiation bar for ghouls. The wild status is shown with the new bar on the right at the bottom above the AP bar. When this drops to 0% (which is currently only possible over time and not through tools) the ghoul is wild and gets:

- +150% melee damage, -300% weapon accuracy
- -5 Stamina
- -30 Max AP
- -99 Charisma
- -30 hit points

These are some negatives, but the +150% melee damage provides a good foundation for a melee build. However, a hybrid of melee combat and firearms is not possible here, as the -300% weapon precision means that you can hardly hit anything anymore. In VATS the chance of hitting is reduced to 0 and outside of it you can only hit with shotguns.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-feral-ghoul-2h-melee-20250314130008-1.jpg)

### Reverse charge with melee

Another basis is the new onslaught mechanic, which we can also use for close combat. Unfortunately, not all Onslaught perks can be used, but the Reverse Onslaught can be used and with Furious and The Masher on a melee weapon we can play with 19 stacks.

Reverse onslaught means that the stacks (5% damage per stack) are built up 1 per second until the Ḿaximum. The maximum is 19 with the two legendary mods: Rasend 9 and Des Masmer 10. So as soon as you enter the game, the stacks build up. When you hit an enemy, one stack is deducted and one stack is added again every second. **This will give you a 95% bonus at 19 stacks for unarmed weapons (like in this build) but also for one-handed and two-handed melee weapons.**

## Weapons and Armor

The primary weapon for the Wild Gunless Ghoul is the Gauntlet. The gauntlet is an unarmed weapon that can be purchased from the settlers for a small amount of gold. The Settlers' Gauntlet is the best unarmed weapon with the mod's energy damage. Alternatively, a death claw glove or a power fist (such as the "Facebreaker" which, however, lacks the 4th legendary mod) is also possible.

This ferocious melee ghoul uses a gauntlet with the legendary mods: Frenzy, The Radaurabauker, Strength and The Masher.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-build-ghoul-unarmed-20250314121619-1.jpg)

The armor is a Secret Service armor with the legendary mods: Automatic Stimpack + The Vanguard, Mix of Poison Resistance / Strength / AP Acceleration, Thru Hikers and on the 4th slot "The Thug".

Which armor you use is not important, the first mod can also be different. I found Vanguard useful and added an Auto Stim part to have a parachute in boss fights. The Queen can hit pretty hard, despite the Blocker Perk. Of course it is also possible e.g. a chameleon armor to further improve your stealth ability. Only Unyielding has no advantage here since you are not playing with low life. Construction technician armor also makes sense, as the set bonus brings with it a melee damage bonus.
